title: Keep the database private, with Compose
summary: All three parts share one network, so web can reach the database. Give compose.yaml two networks so only api can.

tasks.title: `api` is on two networks
tasks.hint: At the bottom of `compose.yaml`: `networks:` with `front:` and `back:` under it. Then under `api`: `networks:` `- front` `- back`. Apply with `docker compose up -d`.

tasks.title: `web` and `db` share no network at all
tasks.hint: `web` gets `networks:` `- front` only, `db` gets `- back` only. A service with no `networks:` line goes on `default`, so give all three one.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:3503` still works, with no red error
tasks.hint: "web can't reach the api": web and api don't share `front`. "api can't reach the database": api and db don't share `back`.

tasks.title: You saved a note, and it shows in the list
tasks.hint: Open http://localhost:3503, write a note, press Save.
